//: Zigbee presence sensors (via Zigbee2MQTT) and the EISY variable each one drives.
//ieee: Keyed by IEEE address, not Zigbee2MQTT friendly name, so renaming a device in the Z2M UI doesn't unwire it.
//eisy: eisy is the index into EISY_URLS (0-4). varType 1 = integer, 2 = state.
//writes: Presence on writes 1; presence off writes 0, but only after this service has itself seen presence on. A service restart therefore never turns a room's motion lights off.
